Watch Rome build the Colosseum: 8 years in 34 seconds. ⏱️

Nero's private lake drained. A concrete ring foundation. 80 arches per tier, rising in travertine set without mortar and pinned with about 300 tons of iron clamps. Three arcades, a solid attic, seats for 50,000. Opened in 80 AD.

The finishing touch: a giant retractable awning over the crowd, rigged by sailors from the Roman navy. ⛵

Would you have sat in the top row? Yes or no 👇

Next: the Golden Gate Bridge. Follow so you don't miss it.

Nero's lake drained, a concrete ring foundation, 80 arches per tier in travertine set without mortar and pinned with ~300 tons of iron clamps, a solid attic, seats for ~50,000, opened by Titus in 80 AD, then the velarium: a retractable awning worked by sailors from the fleet at Misenum.

Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colosseum
